set.approach: Class 3 to 5 lines on O'Malley start from the Little O'Malley switchbacks; climb them, then continue on the trail through the Ballpark. The route is on the north-facing Upper Deep Lake Cliff, above Deep Lake, on the buttress stacked above the one that holds Unemployment Line.
set.descent_text: Walk off the top of the cliff to the west and rejoin the main O'Malley trail, or rappel back down the route.

review.notes: Descent from the route page; approach from area page and both route Locations.

set.approach: Class 3 to 5 lines on O'Malley start from the Little O'Malley switchbacks; climb them, then continue on the trail through the Ballpark. The route starts up a slabby dihedral that faces left, on the right-hand end of the north-facing wall over Deep Lake, at roughly 4,000 feet. Early in the season you may step from snow straight onto the rock; later the start is from talus.

review.notes: Approach only; the route ends at a ledge and no descent is stated.

set.approach: Class 3 to 5 lines on O'Malley start from the Little O'Malley switchbacks; climb them, then continue on the trail through the Ballpark. The line begins midway up the buttress, directly over the top of Unemployment Line: either climb that route first, or scramble to the base from the gully on the right.
set.descent_text: From the top, walk off the buttress to the right into the gully, or scramble easy fifth and fourth class to the summit.

review.notes: Single route page for descent and start; identity fits 2 pitches at 5.9.

set.descent_text: From the summit, put on crampons and descend west on snow or ice until the scree slopes leading toward Twincicle Pass appear. Go down through Twincicle Pass and the Twincicle Valley, which is a tangle of alders, and cross the short but very steep Twincicle Glacier.

review.notes: Descent only, one source; no trailhead-to-base approach for this ridge is stated.
